name: Sub Mission on Seed and Planting Material (SMSP)
eligibility_facts: source specifically states small or marginal farmer for the listed beneficiary section
hard_exclusions: do not assume every SMSP component is available to an individual farmer
questions: Are you seeking seed for your own farm, or do you want to start a seed-related business/infrastructure project?
temporal_note: The source combines multiple components with different beneficiary types; component-level eligibility must be checked.

eligibilityCriteria.source_text: source specifically states small or marginal farmer for the listed beneficiary section

description.en: The applicable SMSP component and its beneficiary category must be confirmed separately; individual access cannot be assumed for every component.
description.or: ଲାଗୁ ହେଉଥିବା SMSP ଅଂଶ ଏବଂ ତାହାର ଲାଭାର୍ଥୀ ଶ୍ରେଣୀକୁ ଅଲଗା ଭାବେ ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରିବା ଦରକାର; ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ଅଂଶରେ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିଗତ ଲାଭ ମିଳିବ ବୋଲି ଧରାଯାଇପାରିବ ନାହିଁ।
